summary: Satya, co-host and co-creator of the Melanin Millennials podcast, details her removal from the show by Shout Out Network (SON) after they unilaterally changed the format and hired new hosts without her consent. She reveals that SON registered the show's trademark without her knowledge in September 2016 and denies her rights as a co-creator despite a verbal agreement that she and MRL Morgan owned the content. Satya states her intention to reclaim ownership of the content she created to amplify the voices of Black British millennials.
